title: Corn Goddess Vision
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a stylized profile of a woman with golden headdress and ornate earrings, her form merging with flowing purple and green smoke. To the left, vibrant blue corn stalks with detailed husks and golden cobs rise upward, surrounded by glowing yellow orbs against a radiating background of blue, purple, and golden light rays.
